### Even If You Labor “for Nought”
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/even-if-you-labor-for-nought
Passage: Isaiah 49:4
Points:
- Believers regularly face discouragement when prolonged labor appears fruitless or unappreciated.
- God evaluates His servants by their faithful, Christ-dependent labor rather than visible results.
- The servant's cry in Isaiah 49:4 serves as a spiritual weapon against despair.
- Christians can overcome the temptation to quit by looking to the Lord rather than human approval.
- We can boldly rest in the assurance that our true vindication and reward remain with God.

### The Walls of Your Life
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-walls-of-your-life
Passage: Isaiah 49:15-16
Points:
- God reassures His people that their lives and struggles remain continually before Him.
- Just as Jerusalem's physical walls suffered ruin, our spiritual boundaries can slowly crumble through neglect.
- Compromise, lack of discipline, and procrastination open doors for destructive habits to take root.
- The Holy Spirit faithfully prompts us to recognize the broken areas in our lives.
- Believers must honestly inspect their spiritual condition rather than treating God's standards lightly.

### The Marks of Love
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-oct-3-2006-1431642.html
Passage: Isaiah 49:16
Points:
- Human commitments often falter, leaving painful wounds of rejection and unfaithfulness.
- God assures His people of an unbreakable bond that will never forsake them.
- Being inscribed on God's palms represents a permanent, unerasable claim of love.
- The cross and the nail-scarred hands of Jesus serve as ultimate proof of this devotion.
- Experiencing God's unchanging faithfulness empowers believers to release bitterness and forgive others.

### Never Lost
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-sept-22-2009-11608745.html
Passage: Isaiah 49:16
Points:
- People often put identification tags on items because earthly belongings easily get misplaced.
- God never loses track of His children, nor does He ever forget them.
- When feelings of isolation or insignificance arise, believers are reminded their names are inscribed on God's palms.
- No spiritual power or circumstance can separate a believer from the Father's grasp.
- Recognizing God's attentive ownership brings security and leads the heart to worship.
